title: Security
scanning: Checking the dashboard, the server, the computers and the repository…
investigating: The AI is looking around: a minute or two…
neverChecked: Nothing has been checked yet: press “Check now”.
readOnly: The agent only looks and tells — it changes nothing by itself.
ownerOnly: The security agent reports to the owner of this dashboard only.

areaHints.host: no report: the server’s scan is installed by deploy.sh on the next deploy
areaHints.desktop: no computer with the desktop app is registered (Activity → Setup)
areaHints.repo: name the repository in the settings below; needs a GitHub token in Integrations

nothing: Nothing found. Everything checked is in order.
noAi: No AI connection: add one in Settings → Integrations, or the rules alone keep checking.
aiFailed: The AI provider did not answer (a wrong key, no credit, or it is down). The findings of the rules are not affected.
failed: It did not work. Try again in a minute.

settings.title: Settings of the agent
settings.aiHint: Without it the rules still check every hour. The AI sees only what the checks collect — never your diary, finances or other records — and has no way to change anything.
settings.connectionHint: A connection of its own keeps the agent apart from the assistant
settings.repositoryHint: owner/name — its security workflow and alerts are watched
settings.invalid: The repository must look like owner/name.
